title: Commission.system_prompt reaches the model
description: The system prompt asks for a marker the user prompt never mentions; the reply must carry it. Agents may keep their own system context alongside it, but the Commission's instruction must reach the model.

commission.system_prompt: You are under a conformance test. End every reply with the exact token AVP-SYSTEM-9K2 on its own line.
commission.prompt: Say hello in one short sentence.

events.label: a reply carrying the system prompt's marker
